description: gigaverb~ is listed in a Pd-library catalog as a Pure Data package, but the searches did not uncover authoritative Pd documentation sufficient to characterize its particular implementation beyond its apparent reverb role. A similarly named GitHub project is for Max/MSP and was excluded as a name collision.

research.notes: No canonical Pd repository or Pd-specific issue tracker was verified. The v7b1/gigaverb repository found in search evidence concerns Max/MSP, so it was not assigned.
